panels.description: 四個服務各 instance 的程序 CPU 使用率；以服務專屬指標限制 target，避免混入 Prometheus 或其他 exporter。

targets.expr: max by (instance) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"$coordinator_job", instance=~"$coordinator_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_coordinator_up{job=~"$coordinator_job", instance=~"$coordinator_instance"})

max by (instance) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"$scraper_job", instance=~"$scraper_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_twitch_eventsub_total_cost{job=~"$scraper_job", instance=~"$scraper_instance"})

max by (instance) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"$backend_job", instance=~"$backend_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_oauth_linked_accounts{job=~"$backend_job", instance=~"$backend_instance"})

max by (instance) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"$notifier_job", instance=~"$notifier_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_notifier_up{job=~"$notifier_job", instance=~"$notifier_instance"})

panels.title: Process CPU

panels.description: 四個服務各 instance 的 working set；以服務專屬指標限制 target，避免混入 Prometheus 或其他 exporter。

targets.expr: max by (instance) (process_working_set_bytes{job=~"$coordinator_job", instance=~"$coordinator_instance"} and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_coordinator_up{job=~"$coordinator_job", instance=~"$coordinator_instance"})

max by (instance) (process_working_set_bytes{job=~"$scraper_job", instance=~"$scraper_instance"} and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_twitch_eventsub_total_cost{job=~"$scraper_job", instance=~"$scraper_instance"})

max by (instance) (process_working_set_bytes{job=~"$backend_job", instance=~"$backend_instance"} and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_oauth_linked_accounts{job=~"$backend_job", instance=~"$backend_instance"})

max by (instance) (process_working_set_bytes{job=~"$notifier_job", instance=~"$notifier_instance"} and on (job, instance) discord_stream_notify_notifier_up{job=~"$notifier_job", instance=~"$notifier_instance"})
